name: ERP7 Solutions Sync for Odoo and WooCommerce
author: Niraj Gupta

sections.description:
ERP7 Solutions Sync for Odoo and WooCommerce connects your WooCommerce store to your Odoo ERP system through the OdooConnector cloud service.

What this plugin includes

  • Odoo connection setup and validation
  • Product synchronization (WooCommerce ↔ Odoo)
  • Order synchronization (WooCommerce ↔ Odoo)
  • Customer synchronization (WooCommerce ↔ Odoo)
  • Inventory sync support
  • Dashboard, logging, and HPOS-compatible order handling
  • Secure webhook callbacks for sync status

All built-in sync features are available in this plugin without a license unlock or trialware gate. The OdooConnector service may enforce plan limits (for example, a free allowance of order syncs per month); those limits are enforced by the external service, not by disabling plugin code.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • An Odoo instance (URL, database, username, password)
  • Network access to the OdooConnector service (see “External services” below)

External services

This plugin relies on OdooConnector (https://odooconnector.cloud), a cloud middleware service operated by the plugin author, to perform synchronization between WooCommerce and Odoo. The plugin does not sync to Odoo without it.

What the service does: it receives sync requests from your store, connects to your Odoo instance on your behalf, and executes the operations you request (products, orders, customers, inventory).

Free plan quota: without a paid OdooConnector plan, the service allows up to 10 successful order syncs per calendar month and may reject further syncs with a quota error. A paid service plan enables unlimited order sync on the middleware. This plugin does not disable its own sync functions when that service limit is reached.

Subscription billing for the service is processed by Stripe.

Data sent to the service:

  • Your site URL — sent automatically, as soon as the plugin is active, to check your subscription status
  • Your Odoo connection details — Odoo URL, database name, username, and password — sent and stored by the service once you enter them and test/save the connection
  • A webhook secret — shared with the service on login/register so sync completion callbacks can be authenticated
  • Your WordPress admin email — sent once you subscribe, used for billing and service notifications
  • The WooCommerce data being synchronized (products, orders, customers) — sent once you connect and sync

By activating the plugin you consent to your site URL being sent for subscription-status checks; by configuring the connection you consent to your Odoo credentials and WooCommerce data being transmitted to and processed by the OdooConnector service.

  • Service website: https://odooconnector.cloud
  • Terms of Use: https://odooconnector.cloud/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://odooconnector.cloud/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/erp7-solutions-sync-for-odoo-and-woocommerce/ (or install via WordPress admin)
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → ERP7 Sync and enter your Odoo URL, database, username, and password, then test the connection
  4. Configure sync preferences and save
  5. Optionally subscribe to the OdooConnector service from the Features tab for unlimited middleware order sync
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a paid service?

No. Connection and all plugin sync features work without a paid plan. The OdooConnector free plan allows up to 10 order syncs per month (enforced by the service). Unlimited order sync on the middleware may require a paid OdooConnector plan. Billing is handled via Stripe on the Features tab when you subscribe.

Are any features locked behind a paid upgrade in the plugin?

No. Product, order, and customer sync are fully available in this WordPress.org plugin. OdooConnector may enforce service plan limits; that is separate from plugin feature access.

Which Odoo versions are supported?

The service adapts to your Odoo version through a single unified API. Support for Odoo 16–18-specific features (e.g. Connector Server, API key) is planned for a future version.

Is HPOS supported?

Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

1.0.0

  • Initial public release as ERP7 Solutions Sync for Odoo and WooCommerce
  • Product, order, customer, and inventory sync through OdooConnector
  • WordPress.org compliance: no trialware or plugin-side feature locks
  • Mandatory webhook secret (hash_equals); guest orders on import
  • Text domain aligned to plugin slug erp7-solutions-sync-for-odoo-and-woocommerce
  • Dashboard, logging, HPOS-compatible order handling
